author: WP19
summary: New (untracked) chapter summarising the Inspector: activation, transport, security, views, status and non-goals. The Inspector user guide and internals page already carry far more; the chapter's JSON serialization, WebSocket bridge, owner-readable token file and standard-library networking claims are wrong at TARGET and were corrected, and its non-goals were added to the guide as an expansion.

concepts.text: The Inspector is an opt-in, view-only diagnostics observer, not an editor: an in-process agent reads the Diagnostics provider on one background thread and speaks an authenticated binary TCP protocol to a separate bridge that serves a browser UI over loopback HTTP; the unit's "HTTP/WebSocket bridge" is wrong, there is no WebSocket.

CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR=ON builds CNA::Inspector and the cna-inspector bridge; a game must link the module and call Agent::Start, with no static initializer or environment hook, so without the option or the call there is no code, listener or thread; STATS yields frames, metrics and resources and FULL is needed for zones, markers and events.
tokens: no static initializer, no environment hook and no automatic Game change

concepts.text: The agent serves one bounded request at a time on its own thread and backpressure from a slow client stops there, so the game thread never waits on the network; it can still be delayed by lock contention while a large snapshot is copied inside Diagnostics. Previews are separate opt-in requests with type, dimension and byte ceilings.
tokens: network backpressure stops at the agent thread
concepts.note: Nuance added by TARGET reading: the game thread can feel the snapshot copy through the diagnostics mutexes.

concepts.text: Claim that the agent serializes protocol-version-1 JSON: the agent speaks a compact little-endian binary protocol (24-byte CNAI header) and never builds JSON; only the bridge translates to JSON for the browser.

Loopback is the default; a session needs the authentication token and a version and capability handshake before any diagnostics are read, a non-loopback bind needs allowRemote, and the data exposed (names, timings, resource metadata, preview pixels) makes remote exposure a host decision to be protected like a debug service.
tokens: checked before the provider is ever queried

concepts.text: Claim that tokens can be supplied through an owner-readable file: --token-file reads a bounded (256-byte) file and strips CR/LF but checks no ownership or permissions; keeping it owner-readable is the caller's job.
tokens: does not check the file's ownership or permissions

concepts.text: The bridge serves bundled static assets and proxies only the Inspector protocol; it binds its HTTP listener to 127.0.0.1, requires an exact Host header and a per-process UI token on every API call, and executes no game commands.

The UI shows session state, frame history, metrics, resources, CPU zones, events and bounded previews; it polls every 500 ms with event cursors, fetches resources only on demand, and reports history overwrite and producer drops rather than presenting a complete trace (the unit's "subscribes to requested streams" is polling, and every snapshot request copies the whole registry in-process).
tokens: A discontinuity banner reports events lost since the UI connected

concepts.text: Claim of standard-library networking and generated browser assets: the module uses OS sockets and OS randomness (POSIX sockets and /dev/urandom, Winsock2 and BCryptGenRandom) with hand-written assets embedded in WebAssets.cpp, and CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR is a configure error on Emscripten, Android and iOS.
tokens: Only the standard library and OS sockets/random are used

concepts.text: Tests cover negotiation, bad authentication, malformed and bounded requests, reconnect, snapshots, events and previews over real loopback, but not the WebBridge; benchmarks separate linked-but-not-started and idle cost from live snapshot and preview work on one recorded machine, which is regression evidence, not a latency promise; no workflow builds the Inspector.
tokens: no test drives WebBridge at all
concepts.note: DI#performance: "put the linked-but-not-started and idle-agent cases within noise".

concepts.text: The Inspector does not attach to arbitrary processes, discover games on a network, edit scenes or assets, or make Diagnostics lossless; extensions must stay separately versioned, bounded, authenticated and opt-in so an observer does not become a game-management surface.

target.evidence: modules/inspector/src (no broadcast or discovery code); docs/inspector.md (deferred list)

concepts.text: Security boundary: 'Non-loopback exposure is a host decision and must be protected like a debug service: Inspector can reveal names, timings, resource metadata and selected preview pixels.'
concepts.note: Added by the post-Phase-3 adversarial audit (finding ch69-inspector-F1): the source statement had no concept in the Phase-3 ledger.
tokens: can read what the Inspector shows,

issues.text: No workflow or preset enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so the 27 Inspector tests never compile in CI; the WebBridge has no automated test; macOS runtime is unvalidated.
